business_problem: Holmes Murphy needed to eliminate data silos and manual processes. Insurance brokerages and agencies are under pressure to become more organized, efficient, and streamlined to thrive in today’s market.
solution_summary: Time-saving sales automation improves operational efficiency. Holmes Murphy used Sales Cloud to create a simplified client intake form and a producer desktop that visually represents each step in the sales process. This helps keep data consistent and sales procedures organized. It gets rid of spreadsheets, reduces repetitive data entry, and improves sales routines with smart workflows. The sales team also gets better analytics through Salesforce Lightning dashboards. Now, with just a few clicks, they can access key data such as monthly client submission flow, market profitability, and sales goals. Our teams use automation to simplify how we handle new business, renewals, and so much more. With Salesforce, we’ve achieved millions in cost savings and saved thousands of employee hours while delivering better client experiences.

solution_components.name: Financial Services Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores insurance and client-service workflows teams use to automate intake, renewals, compliance workflows, and claims servicing.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores account, opportunity, and workflow data teams use to automate intake, renewals, compliance workflows, and claims servicing.

solution_components.name: Service Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores cases, knowledge, and service context that supports teams as they automate intake, renewals, compliance workflows, and claims servicing.

solution_components.name: Marketing Cloud
solution_components.role: Orchestrates personalized campaigns and outreach that support how teams automate intake, renewals, compliance workflows, and claims servicing.

solution_components.name: Experience Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the self-service portal through which users access workflows that help teams automate intake, renewals, compliance workflows, and claims servicing.

business_outcome: Holmes Murphy saved 44,000 hours and $6.9 million in employee-benefits workflows, saved another 3,200 hours and $85,000 in compliance work, and now receives 70% of claims online.
architecture_clues: Sales Cloud automates client intake, producer workflows, and at-risk account alerts.
Experience Cloud provides a portal for real-time claims filing and status tracking.
Service Cloud creates action tasks for the claims team when portal submissions arrive.

Insurance brokerages and agencies are under pressure to become more organized, efficient, and streamlined to thrive in today’s market.

To support ‌the company’s rapid growth, Holmes Murphy needed to make meaningful changes, including consolidating client data, simplifying sales routines, and driving service automation to achieve significant cost savings and time.

data_flow: Client intake, renewal, compliance, and claims data flows through Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, automation triggers risk alerts and emails, and Experience Cloud captures claim submissions that are routed back to service teams in real time.
